items.title: The Appearance of Greek and Roman Mythology in Medical Language
items.detail: Studies mythology in medical language through historical and literary analysis under Dr. Stephen Russell. Nine unit undergraduate thesis, HTHSCI 4A09 A/B.

items.title: Anatomical Terminology Research and Conference Abstracts
items.role: Research collaborator with Dr. Stephen Russell, McMaster University
items.detail: Researched anatomical terminology, developed teaching games and lecture material, and coauthored a Vienna conference presentation and two ICAM 2027 abstract drafts. The work combined HTHSCI 3H06 with its HTHSCI 4D03 continuation.

items.title: Medical Terminology Games
items.detail: Developed and tested educational games for medical terminology and anatomical Latin with Dr. Stephen Russell, including rules, learning materials and digital editions. This work forms part of the anatomical terminology research project.

items.title: Tachyboard
items.detail: Built a typing analysis and practice tool with personalized drills based on recurring typing errors.

items.title: Searing Stories
items.role: Co host, photographer and web designer
items.detail: Organizes dinner interviews, guest outreach, photography and editorial features with Edward Gao. Builds the publication’s website and visual presentation.

items.title: ConspiraSea Online
items.detail: Designed the tabletop social deduction game, original roles and artwork, then developed a multiplayer online edition.

items.title: Wattleseed
items.detail: Developed and produced a short film about two researchers, an artificial intelligence and their response to institutional delay.

items.title: Waterbear and watch restoration
items.detail: Developed an automatic watch and practiced assembly, restoration and quality assessment. The commercial watchmaking role began in August 2025.

items.title: Inqling
items.role: Co creator, collaborative card game and curriculum
items.detail: Co designed a classroom card game with students and faculty to support dialogue and belonging. Presented the learning design at McMaster’s Innovations in Education Conference in 2024.

items.title: Murder of Minus
items.detail: Co wrote and co directed the film with Artyom Gabtraupov and performed the roles of Quinten and Minus. Production concluded in January 2025, followed by festival distribution.

items.title: Transit
items.detail: Developed a CARS reading practice prototype which generates passages for reading endurance and comprehension.

items.title: Full House
items.detail: Designed, illustrated and playtested an asymmetrical strategy game for two to nine players, with nine factions, alliances and custom components.

items.title: willchai.com
items.detail: Builds and maintains a personal website for photography, film, games and other projects.

items.title: HTHSCI 3DM3 Finale Championship
items.detail: The team’s medical science communication video received first place in the course finale at McMaster University.

items.title: Alternative Film Festival
items.detail: Recognized for a lead performance in Murder of Minus.

items.title: Murder of Minus festival awards

items.title: Wattleseed festival awards
